parametric-functions-trace.alt: The curve x(t) = t squared minus 2t, y(t) = 2t minus 1 for t from -1 to 3, a parabola opening to the right. Points are marked at t = -1 (3, -3), t = 0 (0, -1), t = 1 (-1, 1), t = 2 (0, 3) and t = 3 (3, 5). Arrows show the point moves left and up until t = 1, then right and up.

parametric-functions-loop.alt: The path x(t) = t squared minus 4, y(t) = t cubed minus 4t for t from -2.5 to 2.5. Points are marked at t = -2 (0, 0), t = -1 (-3, 3), t = 0 (-4, 0), t = 1 (-3, -3) and t = 2 (0, 0). Arrows show the direction of travel: in from the lower right, up through the origin, around a loop on the left going counterclockwise in the order t = -1, 0, 1, back through the origin, and out to the upper right.
